continuity: All six auxiliaries survived Operation Narrow Furnace.
Lancer 1 and Lancer 2 remain confirmed losses.
IRIS Sahand, IRIS Dena, and Dagger remain confirmed RED losses.
Falakhon and Khanjar remain operational because their prior health-zero events lacked weapon attribution.
Wildcat 1 remains under repair and is not included in the mission.
The expanded forces are theater reinforcements committed during the 24-hour operational pause, not retroactive campaign survivors.

mission_threads.name: Island Lance
mission_threads.purpose: Escort Osprey and heavy-lift waves to establish a Greater Tunb lodgment under attack-helicopter and fighter cover.

mission_threads.name: Furnace Exit
mission_threads.purpose: Complete the six-ship sealift passage with the surviving campaign escort.

mission_threads.name: Razor Screen
mission_threads.purpose: Use SEAD, electronic attack, and standoff strike packages against the mainland coastal and air-defense belt.

mission_threads.name: Silent Gate
mission_threads.purpose: Use submarines, maritime patrol aircraft, and shipborne helicopters to isolate hostile raiders and submarines.

mission_threads.name: High Cover
mission_threads.purpose: Defeat the Iranian reserve fighter and strike packages while protecting the air assault.

mission_threads.name: Open Ledger
mission_threads.purpose: Deconflict fifteen neutral merchants; at least twelve must survive.

design_notes: The September 19 build's group auto-attack and formation-leader controls are called out in the briefing for package management.
The updated grounding avoidance supports the expanded surface order of battle, but every scripted naval position and route still passes project coastline validation.
Corrected anti-air gun ranges make close FAC overflight less misleading; strike routes and briefing language reinforce the standoff lesson from Narrow Furnace.
The air assault is represented by active transport aircraft routing to a friendly expeditionary LZ, with a pre-inserted pathfinder element and landing craft follow-on.
